editorial:
A charming stranger shows up at the Peterson family's door, claiming to be a friend of their son who died in action. He is polite, helpful, and soon everyone trusts him. But then people around them start dying in strange accidents, and you realize something is very wrong. The movie pulls you in fast and keeps you guessing the whole time. You never quite know what he will do next.

Dan Stevens is fantastic as the mysterious guest, mixing charm with danger in every scene. The action scenes are sharp and exciting, and the pacing never slows down. The dark humor adds a fun twist that keeps things lively. On the downside, the ending gets a little wild and over the top. Still, if you love thrillers with style, this is a great pick. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, you learn the guest is actually a government experiment, a trained killer with no real past. He turns on the Peterson family when they discover the truth. In the climax at the school dance, he fights the military team sent to stop him. The movie ends with him seemingly dead, but a final shot hints he may have survived, leaving you with a chilling open ending.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves stylish thrillers with a mysterious stranger.
